config.note: v48 refuses, for the OsmAnd Skill, taps on the plain SHOW ON MAP row and search text containing a comma, two rules the model broke repeatedly. v47: once the route has a point, a tap on the route panel's Add is refused until the next waypoint has been typed into search (Add places the map centre, still at the previous waypoint). v46: code keeps the last route-panel count the model reported and states route progress and the next waypoint each step; a click while the model describes OsmAnd's Add/Edit Favorite dialog and Save is refused. v45: the reminder states that the route panel's Add never searches and gives the order for later waypoints (search, open place, Back to the panel, then Add). v44: the OsmAnd Skill first opens the task's region (the country after the comma) so the map moves there; a manual check then found the first waypoint without widening the search radius, which the model had abandoned. v43 rejects Type when no GUI tree exists and Android reports no focused text field (it would type into nothing), and the OsmAnd reminder adds the rules ignored in the v42 final evaluation (settlement rows only, never the Favorite button, finish one waypoint first). v42 counts more than 50 clearly changed full-resolution pixels as a visible effect, so small label changes (OsmAnd's search radius) are not mistaken for no progress. v41: the Skill reminder and file state that an empty search result needs INCREASE SEARCH RADIUS, not SHOW ON MAP or zooming. v40: with the Skill enabled, every step's user message restates the waypoint search terms (the system-prompt Skill alone was not followed). v39 keeps the goal turn plus the latest 19 executed turns in each request (an 88-step run hit the provider's prompt limit), stops when a block of 2-6 actions repeats three times in a row, and lets the OsmAnd Skill list each waypoint's search term. v38 allows ten unchanged Waits in a row (was five): a cold OsmAnd start after the snapshot restore showed its logo for over 40 s on the software-rendered emulator. v37 allows 60 s per typed word (was 10 s): OsmAnd searches on every character and one word exceeded 10 s on the software-rendered emulator. v36 bounds unchanged Wait actions separately (stop after five in a row) so a slow splash screen is not mistaken for a no-progress cycle; other actions keep the v29 cycle stop. v35 confirms each screen-recorder clip survives encoder start-up (1.5 s) before GUI actions resume and starts a new clip otherwise (observed: 'unable to configure video/avc codec ... err=-38'); agent behaviour unchanged from v34. v34 keeps the shared ADB server when android_env retries a timed-out command (its kill-server also ended the screen recorder) and adds an optional per-task Skill: instructions/skills/osmand_track.md for OsmAndTrack, written from a manual exploration that passed the official track matcher. evaluate_tasks.py --disable-skills runs the same code without it. v33 launches apps with a 30-second `am start -W` timeout: Android World's 5 seconds expired on a cold OsmAnd start, android_env then restarted the ADB server and that also ended the screen recorder. v32 replaces a recorder clip that ends early (polled each second, logged as RECORDING NOTE) and closes a host adb shell that does not return after SIGINT; agent behaviour unchanged from v31. v31 resolves Launch names like upstream Open-AutoGLM (case/spacing-insensitive; a translated non-Latin name resolves only when exactly one app is allowed) and stops on all-black screenshots as a rendering infrastructure error. v30 adds SimpleCalendarAddOneEvent (medium) and OsmAndTrack (hard) with visible completion rules and initial step/time budgets of about 2x and 1.5x their 17/60 reference steps, to be revised from learning trials; Calendar verifier rows are withheld from model inputs. v29 follows pinned Open-AutoGLM English contract and sourced Android World guidance. Long task recipes and Clock keypad Type exception withdrawn. Short visible goals, ordered native history, latest screenshot, checked GUI state and actual selected-control feedback. Bounded recorder readiness and observed EditText recognition repair recorded adapter faults. Scheduler stops at the first failed clean trial; repeated unchanged action cycles stop without forcing completion. Sixteen offline checks; live task-specific v20/v28 gates and unresolved Timer/Clipboard errors are in docs/WARMUP_RESULTS.md. Sources/slide mapping: docs/COURSE_AND_UPSTREAM_REVIEW.md.
